decisions.reason: The firm invested in developing this two-component injection unit only a year ago and gave it a dedicated page, and plural-component injection is central to its announced direction, so management would persist with it.
This is a recent, publicly presented injection unit that fits the firm's tailored-solutions strategy, and any weak early sales can still be attributed to the launch phase.
Automatic airless guns are core to the spray application business, and the sunk development and tooling costs argue for keeping it.
Manual airless guns are a staple accessory that complements the firm's pumps, and the firm has committed to it publicly.
This multi-model air-assisted airless line represents a large investment and a visible commitment to the core spray technology.
The data logger signals the firm's move toward innovative, digital application technology, so management would justify it as strategic even if early uptake is modest.
